claims.content: Diverges from Step 3: when TN A is controlled by own unit (subject of a J10.5 Controlling Unit Report), decorrelation is manually initiated rather than automatic; upon manual decorrelation, C2 JU alerts the operator to report termination of control on TN A.

Diverges from Step 3: when TN A has been paired by own unit (subject of a J10.6 message), C2 JU decorrelates and alerts the operator as a cue to terminate the pairing on TN A and initiate the pairing on TN B if appropriate.

Diverges from Step 3: when selecting the TN to be dropped during decorrelation, if a TN has any of the OCCs listed in paragraph 4.4.4.3.1g(6 7), C2 JU excludes it from automatic selection; absent such a selection constraint, C2 JU selects the higher TN as the TN to be dropped.

Diverges from Step 3: when own unit has R² for the Dropped TN, C2 JU transmits a J7.0 (ACT = 0) Drop Track message for the Dropped TN; if the Dropped TN is subsequently reported by another IU after transmission, C2 JU retains it as a remote track and does not reattempt to correlate the Retained TN and the Dropped TN for 60 seconds after transmission.

claims.content: At Step 1, if local/remote data held indicates any of the following conditions — (1) an Identity (ID) difference constituting a conflict; (2) different Mode II codes with the local Mode II code current; (3) both tracks are locally derived real-time tracks; or (4) either track has its Strength field set to a value greater than 1 — C2 JU shall not automatically correlate the two tracks. These restrictions do not apply to manual correlation, and no other correlation restrictions shall be applied for two tracks that pass the specified correlation tests. Exit: automatic correlation is inhibited; manual correlation remains permitted.

At Step 1, when an initialization parameter or operator-selectable capability is set to inhibit the automatic restriction for ID conflicts or Mode II code mismatches, subject to interface coordination and promulgation to all C² IUs, the automatic restriction is inhibited. If no specific interface direction exists, all IUs restrict automatic correlation by default. Exit: the restriction is either inhibited by the configured override or applied by default.

At Step 1, if the automatic correlation test fails during decorrelation execution, C2 JU assigns a new Track Number (TN B) to the local track and reports TN B in a J3.2 or J3.3 message. Exit: the track is reported under TN B.

At Step 4, if an operator action has selectively released a new local track for reporting, C2 JU shall transmit it regardless of the results of correlation testing. Exit: the released track is transmitted.
